newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly unchanged.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were mostly unchanged Wednesday, and grain dealers in the U.S. High Plains said movement was patchy.
Grain dealers in Kansas said they saw an increase in new grain sales Tuesday in response to the surge in futures prices.

"Movement was pretty good with the board being up -- I'd say we had an above-average day," a south central Kansas dealer said. "But most of the movement was in corn and milo (sorghum), and people were selling a large amount of new crop. Wheat sales were actually a little disappointing."
At least one Oklahoma dealer said business had been quiet Tuesday despite the rise in wheat, corn and soybean futures prices.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: H=KCBT March wheat futures. K=KCBT May wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
